item.title: Seahawks’ Week 1 win was bigger than the comeback: it may be an early test of QB depth in 2026
item.author: Seahawks Fan Zone
item.description: Seattle opened the season 1-0, but Sam Darnold’s early exit turned a narrow win into an immediate look at how much the Seahawks can absorb if the quarterback situation stays in flux.

item.title: How the Seahawks’ 2026 opener showed a defense built to choke off explosive plays
item.author: Seahawks Fan Zone
item.description: Seattle’s comeback win over New England was more than survival. It suggested the Seahawks may be leaning into a defensive identity built around taking away the deep ball and making opponents play on hard mode.
